headline: Tamil Nadu Government Apologizes In Supreme Court Over Deepam Row
seoTitle: TN Government Apologizes To Supreme Court Over Deepam Row
metaDescription: The Tamil Nadu government apologized in the Supreme Court following a controversy over where the Karthigai Deepam lamp was lit on Thiruparankundram hill.
aiSummaryBullets: The Tamil Nadu government issued an apology to the Supreme Court regarding the Karthigai Deepam lighting after citing a lack of temple board approval.
Contention persists over the ritual location on Thiruparankundram hill, with a local dargah claiming ownership of the site against Hindu worshipper requests.
While the lamp was lit at the traditional location, reports indicate it occurred at the Ucchi Pillayar Temple rather than the disputed pillar site.
aiContextParagraph: The ritual of lighting the Karthigai Deepam on the Thiruparankundram hills has become a point of legal and administrative contention in Tamil Nadu. The state government recently submitted an apology to the Supreme Court, explaining that the procedure followed was due to a lack of formal authorization from the relevant temple board. The dispute involves competing claims over the hilltop, where representatives of a local dargah maintain ownership of the entire area, opposing the lighting of the lamp by Hindu worshippers. Despite previous Supreme Court orders regarding the approved location for the ritual, the ceremony took place at the traditional spot near the Ucchi Pillayar Temple. The incident has drawn attention from political figures, including Tamilisai Soundararajan, who previously raised concerns regarding the enforcement of court directives and safety protocols during the observance of the customary practices.
whyItIsViral: The event is being covered by four independent media outlets with a high velocity of reporting following the state government's apology to the Supreme Court.
